expo.name: Syncourse
expo.// owner: must equal the EAS account that owns extra.eas.projectId — `eas whoami` reports hayrecodes-team. Setting this to a personal username makes every eas command fail with 'does not match owner specified in the owner field'.
expo.// runtimeVersion: MUST stay 1.1.0. expo-updates only serves an update whose runtimeVersion is byte-identical to the installed build's, and the installed APK is 1.1.0 (its AndroidManifest contains exactly one version string, 1.1.0 — no 1.0.0 anywhere). Every 1.1.0 build on EAS reports Runtime 1.1.0/Channel preview; the older 1.0.0 builds report Runtime None, so they cannot receive OTA updates at all. Publishing at 1.0.0 therefore reaches ZERO devices — it is not a wider net, it is a dead letter.
